uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: B2B selling presumes a team: SDRs feeding AEs, managers coaching, ops maintaining systems.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: A solo seller runs every role at once, and the tooling assumption of a supporting cast is the hidden tax on every system they touch.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Every workflow built for handoffs becomes overhead when the same person is both sides of the handoff.
